main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 24-bar return
main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t >= 2 to confirm (with correlation > 0); below 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: Pearson correlation of case forecast and excess return

decided_by: The forecast-weighted mean excess return is above 0 with t >= 2 and the correlation is above 0.
reading: Cases are holding-period bets (forecast rise of >= 2 points from its lowest level on its side since the last bet, from 0 after a flat), the first per 24-bar grid cell from each window's first row, dropped when the 24-bar return leaves the window; the weighted-mean t is the ordinary t of f_i*x_i/mean(f) over cases.
